analogy.rationale: The anti-inflammatory class is annotated to NR3C1 (glucocorticoid receptor), so glucocorticoid receptor agonists share the same receptor and downstream anti-inflammatory transcriptional program; NFkB pathway inhibitors converge on the same downstream inflammatory program, while COX inhibitors and other nuclear receptors give weaker overlap.
